feat(camellia): migrate user domain pages

Summary:
- wire the camellia API client to the legacy woodii token and endpoint
  conventions
- add shared user-domain request helpers and list/form/dialog building blocks
- migrate user manage, user logoff, and user anomalous routes into the
  console shell and navigation

Rationale:
- keep the migrated pages compatible with the existing woodii auth and
  backend contract while auth-guard work is still separate
- reuse one page pattern for list, detail, edit, and status flows so later
  admin migrations stay consistent

Tests:
- pnpm install
- pnpm run check:camellia
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/user/manage
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/user/logoff
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/user/anomalous
